notes: D05-01 (ERPNext Accounts) runs on this same deployment: one instance serves both domain entries, which is why S-2 counts deployments rather than entries. The first boot creates the site and installs the erpnext app, so a cold start can exceed the default verify window. Payroll is out of scope.
